create.name: Santacittarama Buddhist Monastery
create.bio:
Santacittarama is a Buddhist monastery of the Thai Forest tradition in the Sabine hills near Poggio Nativo, in the province of Rieti, about fifty kilometres north-east of Rome. Founded in 1990, it was the first Theravada monastery in Italy, and it belongs to the international family of communities that grew from the teaching of Ajahn Chah and his Western disciple Ajahn Sumedho. Its name means 'garden of the serene heart'. The resident community of Italian, Thai and other monks has been led since 1996 by the English-born abbot Ajahn Chandapalo, a monk since 1982; Ajahn Mahāpañño, from Arezzo, is among the senior monks.

Visitors can join the daily round of morning and evening chanting and meditation without booking, and guests may stay for longer periods by keeping the eight precepts and helping with the work of the monastery; nothing is charged, and the community lives on donations. Monthly practice days combine guided sitting and walking meditation, a shared lunch and a teaching, followed by an open question-and-answer session with a senior monk. Ajahn Chandapalo also leads residential retreats elsewhere in Italy. Talks and question sessions, given mostly in Italian, are streamed and archived on the monastery's YouTube channel, alongside downloadable audio talks and free Italian translations of books by teachers in the lineage.

courses.title: Giornate di pratica
courses.description: A day of practice at the monastery for newcomers and experienced meditators alike, alternating guided sitting and walking meditation with a shared lunch and a teaching. It ends with an informal gathering and the usual question-and-answer session with a senior monk; no booking is needed.

courses.title: Soggiorno al monastero
courses.description: Guests of any background can stay at the monastery and share its daily life, keeping the eight precepts and the customs of the Forest tradition and helping with the community's work. Requests are made in advance by email.
courses.price: Il soggiorno in monastero non ha un costo

courses.title: Ritiro residenziale vicino Piacenza con Ajahn Chandapalo
courses.description: A residential retreat in Italian led by the abbot, Ajahn Chandapalo, at the Pian dei Ciliegi centre near Piacenza. Registration opens in January 2027 through the host centre.

free_resources.title: Discorsi in file audio
free_resources.description: An archive of more than a hundred and fifty recorded Dhamma talks, mostly by Ajahn Chandapalo, each free to stream or download as an MP3.

free_resources.title: Ebooks in italiano
free_resources.description: Free Italian translations of books by monks of the Ajahn Chah lineage, including Ajahn Chah, Ajahn Sumedho, Ajahn Munindo and Ajahn Amaro, offered as downloads.
